method: Original AArch64 instructions plus bounded host Unicorn tests with explicit external service stubs; not REA Evidence

static_regions.role: MC still encoder open/close request and response

stubs: ParameterControl virtual+0xb0/+0xa8 supplies synthetic payload, Yc descriptor and handle by key.
ParameterControl virtual+0x48 records error publication; +0x50/+0x40 record handle set/clear operations.
ConvertCid/ConvertCmdMid return synthetic sentinels0x3344/0x5566; logical inputs are retained.
OsalSndMsg records destination/count/payload and returns without sending.
Error converter returns synthetic0x7abc; no claim about actual vendor error mapping.
Sequence-only tests stub allocation and command constructors, record SetExecCmd/SetNextStatus, and copy/set parameter calls; no constructed command executes.
Other locally defined PLT calls deliberately bind to this ELF original function bodies; unknown external calls abort. Runtime symbol interposition is not simulated.
limits: No codec, MC receiver, firmware process, real resource manager, physical memory or camera executes.
Address-like and unit fields are synthetic transport markers, not a proven physical/virtual resource contract.
The MC request/result boundary has not been joined to saved HEIF image areas or the selected MLUT buffer.
Mode3/4/5 result diagnostics reuse MainJpg/ThmJpg/screenNail labels inside the HEIF class; these labels do not prove the actual encoded bitstream codec.
MC logical-to-wire command binding remains unresolved; stub header values must not be used as actual command IDs.
Numeric enum mappings are proven for byte inputs; meanings such as bitdepth/color standard are not inferred solely from helper names.
The finite CP string inventory is a bounded negative result, not proof that CP lacks HEIF functionality.
